recommended_actions: Keep the live pit grid and temperature gauge visible on failure, freezing and emphasizing the causal cell and out-of-band meter position.
For gas_watch, animate the chosen dispatch, unresolved fault propagation, and stack/alert meter crossing its limit before offering retry.
Give baby_care calls persistent visible effects on the animal or care plan, and replace answer-button rule recall with a more manipulable trend-management loop.
For zoo_checkup, show the animal, selected intervention, burden reaction, and treatment mismatch in-world while retaining the evidence board.
Remove debut_plan's immediate verbal direction to the practice record; use an unstaged refusal or generic/visual nudge first.
